newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA, ZEMES REFUSE MORE DETAIL ON MERGER END.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA, ZEMES REFUSE MORE DETAIL ON MERGER END.

text.p: Leading banks Unibanka and Zemes Banka, which have shocked the financial markets by cancelling a planned merger, refused to make further comment before a press conference in just over one hour's time.
"I cannot say anything more at the moment," Zemes Banka's spokeswoman told Reuters.
She repeated an earlier statement, which said the two banks will now continue to operate normally as two independent banks.
An Unibanka spokeswoman said that all questions would be answered at the press conference.
The two banks earlier announced that a planned merger was cancelled as it seemed that the synergies to be gained from merging would not be as big as originally thought.
They said that the talks on a merger will now cease.
